rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice for the live bird or the species.

example.english: There is a chicken in our backyard.
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 hau6 jyun4 jau5 zek3 gai1

rows.note: Use this specifically for chicken meat eaten as food, rather than the live bird.

example.english: We’re having chicken for dinner tonight.

rows.note: Use this as an insult or description for someone who is a coward.

example.english: You’re such a chicken—you won’t even ride the roller coaster.
example.traditional: 你真係膽小鬼，咁高都唔敢玩過山車。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 daam2 siu2 gwai2 gam3 gou1 dou1 m4 gam2 waan2 gwo3 saan1 ce1
